name: Hip Hop
description: Hip hop from a Bronx block party in 1973 to the most listened-to music in the world: the artists, songs and labels.

checkpoints.name: The Bronx
checkpoints.note: DJs in the Bronx loop the breaks of funk records, and MCs rhyme over them. Rapper's Delight in 1979 puts rap on the radio.

checkpoints.name: The golden age
checkpoints.note: Def Jam, Run-DMC and Public Enemy take rap worldwide. N.W.A makes the West Coast famous, and the rivalry of East and West ends with the deaths of Tupac and Biggie.

checkpoints.name: The top of the charts
checkpoints.note: Jay-Z, Eminem and Kanye West sell millions, streaming makes hip hop the most listened-to music in America, and Kendrick Lamar wins a Pulitzer.
